description:
Garrett O Bric Property Advisors invite you to step into luxury, apartment 1 Southpoint is set in this extraordinary development in the heart of Bray. This exclusive development is home to beautifully designed homes offering a rare opportunity to acquire a town centre home combining contemporary architecture with enduring quality and luxury. Perfectly positioned with a host of local shops, cafes, schools and everyday amenities, quite literally on your doorstep, along with excellent public transport links including Dublin Bus and DART services. This prestigious development is sure to appeal to a wide variety of purchasers and this home must be viewed to truly appreciate all it has to offer. Designed with modern living in mind, the accommodation boasts the perfect balance of living and sleeping accommodation all with an abundance of natural light. The property is further enhanced by designated underground parking and intercom system. Inhabitants of Southpoint benefit from access to a stunning communal Italian rooftop garden ideal for socialising with neighbours or just a tranquil space to sit back and relax. This stunning spacious first floor home is beautifully appointed with a wonderful bright open plan living, dining room with dual aspect windows plus a well equipped kitchen area boasting a fully integrated bespoke handcrafted German kitchen, two sumptuous spacious double bedrooms (primary with ensuite), and complete with a superior bathroom in Italian marble with underfloor heating. 
Bray is truly a wonderful location to call home, it really has it all from the sea to mountains to town centre amenities. With it's super location number 1 is within minutes walk of Brays wonderful Victorian promenade, a stunning place for a gentle stroll or if you are feeling more energetic, the opportunities for watersports abound with sailing, rowing, paddle boarding and kayaking to start plus of course the ever popular sea swimming. Dublin City Centre is less than 20 kilometres away with easy access by DART, Bus or car with the M50 close at hand. 
This home is sure to appeal to a wide variety of purchasers and early viewing is strongly recommended.

Accommodation Extending to 76 square metres

Accommodation 

Entrance Hallway
Welcoming hallway boasting two large storage cupboards providing ample storage and keeping the entrance clutter free. 

Open Plan Living Dining and Kitchen
4.1 x 8.9m 
This wonderful spacious room boasts ample room for designated living, dining and kitchen areas. Bathed in natural light from dual aspect windows and with attractive timber flooring in warm oak flowing seamlessly from the hallway reflecting the light beautifully creating a warm and inviting ambience. The kitchen is truly stunning with an excellent range of high quality hand crafted custom built German kitchen units in contemporary cream high gloss finish. There is ample countertop space for food prep and integrated appliances include a dishwasher, fridge freezer, built in oven, ceramic hob with extractor overhead. A tiled splash back and floor allows for easy maintenance. 

Primary Bedroom 
5.1 x 3.1m 
Sumptuous spacious double bedroom boasting an excellent range of built-in wardrobes providing an abundance of storage, the timber flooring again flows seamlessly from the hallway creating a sense of even further space. The suite is complete with a truly stunning ensuite shower room with high quality sanitary ware and an extensive use of marble. 

Bedroom No. 2
2.9 x 3.3m 
This second bedroom again is a spacious double. 

Bathroom
Truly luxurious main bathroom again with the extensive use of stunning marble on the walls and floor, the sanitary is high quality in classic white with wc, wash hand basin and bath with shower facility overhead. 

Outside: 
A wonderful benefit of living in Southpoint is that the residents benefit from access to a communal Italian roof garden, ideal for socializing with your neighbours or sitting in the sun. The basement is home to a underground parking facility and number 1 is allocated one designated parking space.
